notes.title: Two number systems
notes.text: Hours use native Korean numbers (한 시, 두 시, 세 시), but minutes use Sino-Korean numbers (십 분, 이십 분). 반 means half: 세 시 반 = 3:30. Leaving home, say 다녀오겠습니다 ("I'll go and come back").

notes.title: Days of the week
notes.text: Korean day names come from nature: 월 moon (Monday), 화 fire, 수 water, 목 wood, 금 metal (gold), 토 earth, 일 sun (Sunday).

notes.title: A good night's sleep
notes.text: Koreans wish each other good night with 잘 자요 (to friends) or 안녕히 주무세요 (to elders). The next morning: 잘 잤어요? ("Did you sleep well?").
